If you want to install _this_ particular version of Yarn Spinner for Unity, follow these steps:
Installing Yarn Spinner for Unity v3.2.8 from Git

* Open the Window menu, and choose Package Manager. * If you already have any previous version of the Yarn Spinner package installed, remove it. * Click the `+` button, and click *Add package from git URL...* * Enter the following URL: * `https://github.com/YarnSpinnerTool/YarnSpinner-Unity.git#v3.2.8` Each release will have a different URL. To upgrade to future versions of Yarn Spinner, you will need to uninstall the package, and reinstall using the new URL.

## 📜 Changes - Updated Yarn Spinner DLLs to target .NET Standard 2.1. - Removed a number of unnecessary .NET Standard 2.0 supporting DLLs. - Fixed an issue where IL2CPP builds would fail on Unity 6.5.
